messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@healthlytics.com>

Cc: procurement@healthlytics.com
Date: 2026-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & POC environment details

Hi Maya / Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the routing controls. Procurement asked me to capture the Mutual Action Plan items so they can align internal stakeholders. High-level asks for the POC environment:

- Org and tenant setup: we need a dedicated tenant for Healthlytics evaluation with RBAC for two engineers and one product owner.
- API keys: short-lived keys for the trial (30 days) and a service account for automated testing.
- IP allowlist: we'll provide a CIDR set for outbound firewall rules.
- VPC peering: desire to peer our VPC in us-west-2 for private traffic to the Dedicated endpoint; can you share requirements and timeline?

Attaching a spreadsheet (HL_MAP_v1.xlsx) with proposed dates and internal owners. Can you confirm the earliest window for org creation and an estimated time to get keys + peering completed? Procurement also asked about any standard security questionnaire items we should expect.

Thanks,
Alex
Network & Integrations
Healthlytics

Attachment: HL_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@healthlytics.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & POC environment details

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Below is a proposed boarding track we can commit to for the POC; I’ve translated items into actionable milestones so procurement can slot them into their cadence. Timeline assumes we start org creation on 2026-10-04.

1) Org & tenant provisioning (2 business days) — creates Healthlytics org, invite 3 users, enable audit logging.
2) API key issuance (same day as provisioning) — short-lived API keys + one service account key; we’ll share rotation guidance.
3) IP allowlist validation (1 business day after you send ranges) — we’ll return an allowlist confirmation and test endpoints.
4) VPC peering prep & handoff (3–5 business days) — we’ll provide terraform snippets and a peering checklist for your infra team; peering completion depends on your cloud ops SLA.
5) Test run & baseline eval (3 business days) — smoke tests, latency checks, token cost sampling.

Action items for Healthlytics: send firewall CIDRs and your peering contact. Action items for Redwood: I will open a MAP doc (v1) and provide the peering template + the required IAM role bindings.

Security note: we’ll need the contact who can sign the limited-scope SOC2 evidence request; for the POC we can provide audit logs and flow logs metadata, no customer data is persisted beyond transient caches.

I’ve attached a short network diagram and a filled MAP outline. If that looks ok I’ll lock the dates and share the HubSpot deal with procurement.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-network-diagram.pdf (pdf stub), HL_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated)

- Trial capacity: we can allocate a small Dedicated pool for Healthlytics (2x A100-equivalent) for up to 30 days under the evaluation pricing band.

- Contracting: if they want a short SOW for the Dedicated trial we can prepare a 30-day SOW and a simple order form; procurement may request standard MSA redlines.

If procurement needs a pricing sheet, I can share one by EOD tomorrow. Maya — confirm the start date and I’ll reserve the capacity.
